title: The Pinata Endurance Challenge! IV
description: The Pinata Endurance Challenge! IV — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy 12 Pinatas, Slay 15 Grunt Gladiators, 6 Champion Gladiators, and 2 Hero Gladiators in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy 12 Pinatas, Slay 15 Grunt Gladiators, 6 Champion Gladiators, and 2 Hero Gladiators in the Pinata Endurance Challenge off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

The time has come to show all the Gladiators that you have truly arrived as the Pinata Endurance Challenge champion. You need to go in there and make an example of all that stand against you! Let me read you a great quote from my book of inspirational quotes. Let me find one, here... ah, this one is pretty good. 'When you are up against a monumental challenge make sure to eat a light snack.' There, you ready to take on the world now?

Head off to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 4 of Ratsputin's Gulag to begin the quest. There you will need to destroy twelve Pinatas, slay fifteen Grunt Gladiators, six Champion Gladiators, and two Hero Gladiators. Then you can turn the quest into me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

I just saw a couple of Gladiators running away from the Pinata Endurance Challenge. That must mean that you were really whooping up on them something fierce! Let me know if you want to try it again.

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas
  • Slay Grunt Gladiators
  • Slay Champion Gladiators
  • Slay Hero Gladiators

Client level range: 90–100
